body: On November 5, Lufthansa flight LH463, a Boeing 747-8 taxiing for departure at Miami International Airport, had to make a full stop at full taxi speed after an American Airlines Boeing 787-8 turned into its path. The 747, which bears a special retro livery, was operating the daily scheduled service from Miami to Frankfurt. Its crew told air traffic control they would file a report, saying "that was very close to an accident in the making". The American aircraft had just arrived from Philadelphia as flight AA1155, and controllers said it had "made every wrong turn possible already" and was supposed to hold short of taxiway Yankee.

The close call delayed LH463, which pushed back closer to 5:00 PM against a scheduled 4:40 PM departure and eventually took off 53 minutes late at 5:33 PM, landing in Frankfurt 39 minutes behind schedule at 8:24 AM the next day. Flightradar24 data shows AA1155 landed at 5:15 PM, operated by Boeing 787-8 N803AL, and that the Dreamliner made a right turn in front of the 747 close to where runways 09/27 and 12/30 intersect at around 5:18 PM. American has used the 787-8 on the Philadelphia-Miami rotation since November 1, one of nine or ten daily flights on the route, with the rest flown by Airbus A321-200s, A321neos, Boeing 737-800s and 737 MAX 8s. Simple Flying has reached out to Miami International Airport for further information on the incident.
en.summary: A Lufthansa Boeing 747-8 taxiing for departure at Miami had to stop at full taxi speed after an American Airlines Boeing 787-8 turned across its path on November 5. The 747 later departed 53 minutes late; no collision occurred.
en.title: Lufthansa 747 makes full stop in Miami as American 787 turns into its path

body: 11月5日，漢莎航空一架波音747-8在美國邁阿密國際機場滑行前往跑道時，被迫在全速滑行中急煞停下，因為一架剛降落的美航波音787-8轉進了它的滑行路徑。該航班為每日往返法蘭克福的LH463，機上為一架披有特殊復古塗裝的747-8；機組向塔台表示將提出報告，稱此事「that was very close to an accident in the making」。美航該架787-8當時剛執行自費城抵達的AA1155航班，塔台則表示該機「made every wrong turn possible already」，原本應在Yankee滑行道前停等。

這起險情使LH463延誤：該航班表定下午4時40分出發，實際接近下午5時才後推，最終於當地時間下午5時33分起飛、晚了53分鐘，隔日上午8時24分抵達法蘭克福、晚了39分鐘。據Flightradar24資料，AA1155於下午5時15分降落，由註冊編號N803AL的波音787-8執飛，該機約在下午5時18分於09/27與12/30跑道交會處附近右轉切入747前方。美航自11月1日起在費城至邁阿密航線以787-8執飛AA1155，該航線每日有9至10班，其餘由空中巴士A321-200、A321neo、波音737-800與737MAX8執飛。Simple Flying已向邁阿密國際機場詢問此事，等待進一步說明。
zh.summary: 漢莎航空一架波音747-8於11月5日在邁阿密滑行起飛時，因美航一架波音787-8轉進其路徑，被迫在全速滑行中急煞；747最終晚53分鐘起飛，未發生碰撞。
zh.title: 漢莎747-8邁阿密滑行險撞美航787-8機組急煞：差點釀成事故
